answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 49488 Country: India Title: TV - Wazu & Birthday party Question: Please reply answers to below points. (1) If any one watches TV wudhu will be broken. We have to do once again wudhu for namaz, if we watch TV. (2) As per Ulama, shall we attend birthday parties and eat food there or cakes. Answer ID: 49488 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 26/28/N=01/1435) (1) No, wudhu does not break by watching TV. However, if one discharges madhi or mani in case he watches nude pictures or nasty programme then wudhu shall break in case of madhi and ghusl shall be wajib in case of mani. (2) It is not Islamic method to celebrate birthday and throw party rather it is the invention of other nations hence Muslim should avoid it. Also should not attend such programme and should not eat food or cake etc from there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
